instruction: Look at gui_016_frame_corner.step in SolidWorks, a 90 degree frame corner made from two 30 x 30 x 120 mm square tubes with 3 mm wall thickness. The horizontal tube spans X=0..120, Y=0..30, Z=0..30, and the vertical tube spans X=0..30, Y=0..120, Z=0..30. Add one horizontal triangular gusset plate in the inside corner connecting the inner faces X=30 and Y=30. The gusset plate is 6 mm thick from Z=12 to Z=18 and its projected right-angle legs are each 55 mm, with vertices at (30,30), (85,30), and (30,85). Near the outside end of each tube, add two vertical 8 mm diameter through fixing holes through the top and bottom walls. For the X-direction tube, place the hole centers at X=100 and Y=7 and 23; for the Y-direction tube, place the hole centers at Y=100 and X=7 and 23. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_016_frame_corner_gusset_out.step.
